info.syllabusName: Tiếp thị công nghệ số (Digital Marketing)
info.description: This course provides students a new view about marketing in the era of Internet. Beside introducing knowledge about digital marketing, this course also focuses on supporting students to build marketing plan and implement digital marketing for individuals and organizations in reality.
info.decisionNo: Ban hành theo QĐ CTĐT TDTU

clos.loDetails: Understand the importance of digital marketing in the age of up-to-date techniques, as well as aware of the trends and potential development of digital marketing at present and in the future.
Apply the fundamental principles of a digital marketing strategy know how to combine digital marketing and traditional marketing.
Implement digital marketing channels as well as digital marketing tools to implement digital marketing plan in reality.
Analyse the opportunities and challenges of digital marketing when applying to an individual or organization, especially in Vietnam
Assess a digital marketing strategy in a company
Plan the company’s digital marketing strategy, knowing how to organize, manage, plan and control a digital marketing strategy
Invent knowledge related to business in general and especially in marketing field
Create suitable strategic solutions for company’s digital marketing situations.
